source_title: The Bitter Lesson of Agent Harnesses

source_title: Show HN: Browser Harness - Gives LLM freedom to complete any browser task
claim_summary: Third-party discussion (134 points / 66 comments when read) raises prompt-injection, auditability and ToS concerns; one commenter alleges a privately reported browser-use RCE went unanswered for ~40 days
availability: discussion thread; posting time from official HN item API
limitation: Community comments are unverified; the alleged RCE report is private and could not be confirmed or matched to any advisory

source_title: BUX: Your 24/7 Remote Agent with Browser Harness
claim_summary: Vendor says it is shipping BUX, a 24/7 remote VM with Claude Code and Browser Harness preinstalled, controlled via Telegram/web terminal/SSH; self-host repo linked; managed team pilot priced at $1,000/month
availability: self-host repo plus managed pilot; no beta label
limitation: Isolation claims (zero-permission IAM role; 240-minute session rotation) are vendor statements without a threat model; cookie sync is a high-trust grant

source_title: A Production Architecture for the Browser Use Open-Source Library

feature: reusable deployment pattern for OSS agent
availability: documentation of vendor's own architecture; not a product
limitation: Pattern is vendor self-description; no failure-rate or cost data; hot-Lambda workspace cleanup is the only isolation guidance

limitation: All figures self-measured; cited BrowserArena #1 ranking conflicts with an undated Notte-operated Browser Arena page read 2026-10-16 (rank 6; $0.06/hr)

source_title: How to Use AI Agents for QA Automation

availability: requires Browser Use Cloud API key
limitation: LLM-judged 1-5 score is not a deterministic acceptance test; no false-pass/false-fail rates or limitations stated

availability: methods disclosure; no new open-source release
